name: pointable-context
description: Selection-triggered, zero-turn development context reveal in the native Codex Chat Lane.

interface.shortDescription: Select a reference and reveal verified context in place.
interface.longDescription: Keep the Codex Chat Lane quiet until the user selects a stable file, module, decision, or task reference. A trusted explicit action then reveals bounded, type-specific detail beside the selection without opening a browser, calling a model, or creating another chat turn. Deterministic identity matching and text fallback remain available; semantic concept recognition, App Server browser clients, and DCPM/CWA are not product dependencies.
